item.title: Fake citations make a decision "no decision at all": update
item.description:
Pooja Ramesh Singh v. J&K Bank Ltd., 2026 INSC 668 (Supreme Court)

The question: Effect of NCLT and NCLAT orders relying on non-existent judgments.

Where it stands: 2 July 2026: both orders set aside; citing AI-generated precedents without verification is professional misconduct; the BCI to frame guidelines.

Decided 2026-07-02
